qa_pairs.question: What steps should users take before sending an email to support?
qa_pairs.answer: Before contacting support, users should check the system status page (status.computecanada.ca) to see if their problem has already been reported. They must also ensure that the email address from which they are writing is registered in their account.

qa_pairs.question: What information should be included in the subject line of a support email?
qa_pairs.answer: The subject line of a support email should include the system/cluster name and a brief description of the issue. For example, a good subject line would be "Job 123456 fails to run on the Rorqual cluster."

qa_pairs.question: Which email address should be used for questions specifically about the Trillium cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: For questions or issues specifically regarding the Trillium cluster, users should send an email to trillium@tech.alliancecan.ca.
